subject: general
question: The average height of 25 boys was calculated to be 150 cm. It was detected later that one value of 160 cm was wrongly copied as 135 cm for the computation of the mean. Find the correct mean height (in cm).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net change in sum = Correct value − Incorrect value = 160 − 135 = +25

Change in average = Net change ÷ Total number of boys = 25 ÷ 25 = +1

Correct average = Old average + Change in average = 150 + 1 = 151

**∴ The correct answer is 151 cm.**
